arabic_html:
وَٱلَّذِينَ جَٰهَدُوا۟ فِينَا لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا ۚ
وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَمَعَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ ۞
translation: And those who strive for Us — We will surely guide them to Our ways. And indeed, Allah is with the doers of good.
explanation_html: A promise for the seeker — Ibn Kathīr: those who strive for Allah, He guides to His paths. Begin the effort, and the guidance meets you. And Allah is with those who do good.
explanation_vo: A promise for the seeker — Ibn Kathir: those who strive for Allah, He guides to His paths. Begin the effort, and the guidance meets you. And Allah is with those who do good.
